en: Vintage sepia-toned street view of a European town, showing multi‑story neoclassical buildings on the left, a broad street with pedestrians and a few carts, and low hills in the background. Greek text appears along the bottom left, with a French and Latin‑alphabet caption on the right identifying the scene as a street in Kalamata named Rue Venizelos. A web address is faintly printed across the lower right of the image.
